abstract: As I write these words, I am preparing for the October Board meeting in Los Angeles, just ahead of the SMPTE Annual Technical Confer ence and Exhibition. Like all Board meetings, there is a lot of content to prepare. Board officers, i.e., the Executive Committee, must prepare reports of activities since the last Board meeting. The same is true for the home office staff and me. This meeting is also the point where we present the upcoming year’s annual budget, which is always a fun activity.
